title: The Explorer Who Survived a Bear Attack by Letting It Bury Him Alive
hook: A grizzly mauled him, dug a grave, and covered him with dirt—so he played dead until the bear left, then dug himself out.
why_this_can_go_viral: The visceral imagery of being buried alive by a bear is both terrifying and bizarre, driving high shareability.

title: The Miners Who Ate Fungus Off the Cave Walls—and Got Hallucinogenic Visions
hook: They scraped glowing fungi from the rock and ate it—the hallucinations made them forget they were starving for three days.
why_this_can_go_viral: The accidental psychedelic trip as a survival mechanism is a fascinating and bizarre twist.
